title: Everyday Science for Kids! Magnets, Light, Shadows and Sound with Gizmo
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to explore everyday science.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it can stick to the fridge! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
They pull on some metals, like iron!
Can you pretend your hands are magnets? Pull together, click!
Will a magnet pull a paper clip?
Yes! Paper clips have metal in them.
One more time, nice and loud: MAGNET!
Magnets won't stick to wood or plastic.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it lights up a dark room! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Electricity flows through wires to the bulb.
Can you flick a pretend light switch? On! Off!
What makes a light bulb glow?
Let's say it together: LIGHT BULB!
One more time, nice and loud: LIGHT BULB!
Always ask a grown-up for help with plugs.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's cold, hard, and slippery! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
When ice gets warm, it melts back into water!
Can you melt slowly, like an ice cube, down to the floor?
Let's say it together: MELTING ICE!
One more time, nice and loud: MELTING ICE!
Put water in the freezer, and it turns back into ice!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it follows you on a sunny day! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
When you block the light, you make a dark shape. That's your shadow!
Can you make a shadow puppet with your hands?
What do we need to make a shadow?
Light, and something to block it!
One more time, nice and loud: SHADOW!
In the morning, shadows are long!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: you hear it with your ears! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Sound happens when things shake, or vibrate.
The shaking wiggles the air, and the wiggles reach your ears!
Can you hum and touch your throat? Feel it buzz!
One more time, nice and loud: SOUND!
Loud sounds have big waves. Quiet sounds have small waves.
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
